mapper.select: select sou.user_id as id, su.name, sou.department_id as departmentId, sd.name as departmentName from sys_organization_user sou join sys_user su on su.id = sou.user_id left join sys_department sd on sd.id = sou.department_id where ifnull(sou.enable, true) = true order by ifnull(sd.pos, 0) asc, su.name asc
